details.description:
Celebrate every move with Rexona’s Limited Edition ICC Women’s Cricket World Cup India 2025 Roll-Ons. In partnership with ICC Women’s Cricket, this unique Roll-On is crafted to thrill cricket fans and deodorant lovers alike.
With fragrant notes of Lotus Flower and the nourishment of shea butter, get 72-hour* odour protection. Its delicate floral-fruity fragrance soothes and uplifts your senses. Along with the all new motion-activated scent capsules, release a boost of freshness with every move. While I2 HSA and glycerin help keep underarm skin soft and comfortable, the quick-dry, clear formula rolls on smoothly and helps prevent white marks on clothes. Whether you’re training, commuting, or heading out, this compact roll-on brings strong protection and a delightful scent.
details.usageInstructions:
Step 1: Start with clean, dry underarms. You can shower or wash the area with water and mild soap.
Step 2: Pat your underarms dry with a towel to ensure they are completely dry before applying the roll-on.
Step 3: Take the roll-on deodorant and twist the cap in a counterclockwise direction until it comes off completely.
Step 4: Apply 4-6 swipes over each underarm, applying a thin, even layer of the antiperspirant. This will provide optimal protection against sweat and odour.
Step 5: Allow the antiperspirant to dry completely before dressing to avoid any transfer onto clothing.
Step 6: Replace the cap securely after use to prevent the product from drying out or leaking.
Step 7: Use daily after bathing or as needed for continuous protection against sweat and odour.
